resources.name: β-HMX experimental crystal structure

access.notes: Atomic coordinates from Cady et al. (1963) Acta Crystallogr. 16, 617; also in Choi & Boutin (1970) Acta Crystallogr. B 26, 1235. Can be retrieved from Cambridge Structural Database (CSD) or constructed from published lattice parameters a=6.54 Å, b=11.05 Å, c=8.70 Å, β=124.3°, space group P21/c.

resources.notes: Publicly known structure; no proprietary restrictions.
